title: Creator
summary: For creators and influencers: one clear subscribe action, the latest work as a carousel, every platform in one place, and a door for brands.

notFor: People who mainly want to show written or reported work (start from journalist)

cards.purpose: The one action they most want from a visitor.
Their three to six latest pieces, with thumbnails.
A short story and their house rules (sponsorship disclosure).

slots.ask: What name do you publish under?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: What is the one thing you most want a visitor to do: subscribe, join a newsletter, support you?
slots.write: The first button is that action. Use the subscribe preset for a channel or newsletter; custom with a two-to-four-word label otherwise. Heading = their schedule or promise.

slots.ask: Which three to six recent pieces should visitors see first?
slots.write: tag = format · length; title = the published title; the member uploads each thumbnail in the editor. Use only links they give you.

slots.ask: Which platforms do you post on? Paste your profile links.
slots.write: The URL only; add a label only where the URL names no account.

slots.ask: Do you want brands to contact you? If so, which email address may be public?
slots.write: Publish an email only if they confirm it may be public. Text = what kind of brands they work with.

slots.ask: How did you start, and is there anything every viewer should know (how you disclose sponsorships, for example)?
slots.write: Two or three short lines, in their voice.
